caption: “The Pink Moccasin-Flower - The Stemless Lady’s Slipper,” from Grace Greylock Niles, Bog-Trotting for Orchids, p. 247.
alt: A color plate of a pink lady’s slipper taken apart: the pink, veined pouch, the long brown-red petals and sepals, and smaller parts laid out in rows.
bibliography: Niles, Grace Greylock. "The Pink Moccasin-Flower – The Stemless Lady’s Slipper." Bog-Trotting for Orchids, Knickerbocker Press, 1904.
